Database._comment: PostgreSQL is the hosted/Docker default. Conductor's embedded launcher overrides this with Database__Provider=Sqlite via environment variables.

ForwardedHeaders._comment: Trusted reverse-proxy contract for X-Forwarded-* (issue #125). Base default TrustAllProxies=true preserves the local-development modes' behaviour (Development/Docker/Embedded sit behind a trusted local proxy such as Conductor's unified proxy). Production/UAT override this to false + an explicit KnownNetworks list so a client cannot spoof its IP/scheme. ForwardLimit caps the number of proxy hops unwound.

TokenExchange._comment: RFC 8693 token exchange allow-list (Epic IDP — rivoli-ai/conductor#1246). Each entry permits ActorClientId to act on behalf of users for the named Audience. Anything not listed is denied.

Authorization._comment: Interim role → `permission` claim projection until the full AL-rbac roll-out sources effective permissions from andy-rbac. Downstream services authorize on a flat `permission` claim (e.g. andy-tasks tasks:approvePlan / tasks:editPlan). The plan approval/edit gate is a human-in-the-loop checkpoint, so any authenticated operator (User) may satisfy it in the current single-tenant product; tighten per-deployment by overriding this map.

IpRateLimiting._comment: RealIpHeader is intentionally empty (issue #125): a caller-supplied header like X-Real-IP must never be used as the rate-limit identity, or an attacker rotates it to evade login/token limits. Empty makes AspNetCoreRateLimit resolve the client IP from HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress, which UseForwardedHeaders normalises using the trusted-proxy set above.
